name: Creixell (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with a red ragged saltire (Burgundy cross).
history: The official flag of Creixell is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, purple, with the red cross of Burgundy of the arms, 4/6 of the height of the cloth, at the centre; approved on 25 November 2008 and published in the DOGC on 9 December 2008.

features.role: ragged Burgundy cross of 4/6 of the height
